ns2:course.label: History of Antisemitism
ns2:course.description: Studies the negative representations of Judaism and Jews from antiquity to the modern world. Topics include: Greco-Roman concepts of the Jewish religion; medieval Christian symbolization of the demonic Jew; Jews and negative attitudes to capitalism; blood purity and blood libel; the rise of racial prejudice in the modern nation state; totalitarianism and genocide; antisemitism and anti-Zionism. Same as REL 212.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Humanities - Hist & Phil, and Cultural Studies - Western course.
